title: Yellow Crispy Thai Tiger Prawns Moo Ping
description: A spicy and crispy Thai dish featuring tiger prawns, perfect for a monsoon evening, this low-fat-friendly recipe is a twist on the traditional moo ping street food, with the added benefit of being steamed in leaves for extra flavor
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together rice flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, and Thai red curry paste to the bowl and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Add the tiger prawns to the batter and mix until they are well coated.
Cut the banana leaves into large squares and brush with a little water.
Place a few prawns in the center of each banana leaf square.
Fold the banana leaves over the prawns to form a tight package and steam for 5 minutes.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Remove the prawns from the banana leaves and fry until crispy and golden brown.
Drain the prawns on paper towels and serve immediately.
